title: Comment on “The role of H 3 PO 4  in the preparation of activated carbon from NaOH-treated rice husk residue” by Y. Li, X. Zhang, R. Yang, G. Li and C. Hu,  RSC Adv. , 2015,  5 , 32626
content: In this work, we critically evaluate the proposed formation of phosphine (PH3) during H3PO4-assisted activated carbon synthesis from NaOH-treated rice husk residue. Temperature programmed decomposition-mass spectra (TPD-MS) signals and reaction stoichiometry do not adequately support the proposed mechanism. Background noise, instrumental interference, and alternative reaction pathways are discussed. Further quantitative measurements are needed to verify PH3 formation and clarify its origin.
